high_findings.title: Count KPIs can hide nonzero safety violations
high_findings.finding: evaluate() applies zero-denominator behavior before the numerator_count branch. Consequently, eight unsupported claims with denominator zero evaluates to zero; the test explicitly locks in this incorrect behavior. This contradicts the documented rule that numerator_count returns its numerator and can falsely report zero unsupported claims or unauthorized actions.
high_findings.probable_root_cause: Shared zero-denominator handling was placed before operation-specific count handling.
high_findings.preferred_safe_fix: Validate the scalar numerator, return it for numerator_count before applying denominator-zero behavior, and change the regression test so evaluate(8, 0) returns 8. Consider requiring integral values for count KPIs.

high_findings.title: Evidence verification and confidentiality metadata are not fail-closed
high_findings.finding: verification_status is treated as authoritative without reconciliation to evidence_source.owner_verified; setting owner_verified false with verification_status owner_verified still satisfies eligibility. confidentiality_level is an arbitrary identifier with no enforced meaning, so a confidential label can coexist with public_reference_allowed true, proposal eligibility, and completed-work claims. Existing tests only flip public_reference_allowed and do not cover these contradictory states.
high_findings.probable_root_cause: Related provenance, verification, and confidentiality fields were modeled independently without a cross-field state contract.
high_findings.preferred_safe_fix: Introduce explicit confidentiality and provenance enums and validate every verification status against its required source evidence. Reject confidential or unknown states from proposal eligibility and completed-client-work support. Add negative tests for contradictory owner verification, public verification, confidentiality, and eligibility combinations.

high_findings.title: Unknown schema versions are silently accepted
high_findings.finding: Profile, scoring, and manifest schema versions accept any numeric major.minor string. The current parser therefore accepts unsupported or mutually inconsistent versions such as 2.0 while interpreting them as the current schema, contrary to strict fail-closed configuration validation.
high_findings.probable_root_cause: Schema versions were validated for syntax, not supported-version compatibility.
high_findings.preferred_safe_fix: Require the supported literal version 1.0, or dispatch through an explicit supported-version registry, and enforce compatible versions across all three files. Add rejection tests for unknown and mixed versions.

medium_findings.title: Implementation commit includes durable governance changes outside the M03 vertical slice
medium_findings.finding: The commit modifies repository-wide blocker policy, skill behavior, and its validator in addition to M03 implementation. These changes were requested by the user as Codex control-plane blocker-guidance work and must remain explicitly identified in the milestone record.
